supportingSources.label: Silverball Rules Astro and 4 Square strategy

strategy.overview: 4 Square and Astro revolve around repeating the 1-2-3-4 sequence. Any numbered top lane, side lane, return lane, yellow target, or green target can supply its number. Each completion scores 500 and raises one group from 50 to 200: top rollovers first, yellow targets second, then green targets. Keep collecting numbers, but delay the fourth completion because it changes the green targets to Special instead of scoring points.
strategy.simpleOverview: In 4 Square and Astro, complete 1-2-3-4 using any numbered lane or target. Each completion scores 500. The first raises the top lanes from 50 to 200, the second raises the yellow targets, and the third raises the green targets. Try to delay the fourth completion because the green targets then score Special instead of useful tournament points.
strategy.summary: Shoot upward and let the numbered feeds complete three sets naturally. Then identify the missing number and avoid it while repeating 200-point lanes and targets. Read side-lane exits early because their posts can send the ball toward either flipper or outlane.

quickInfo.name: First completion
quickInfo.summary: Raise all top rollovers from 50 to 200.

quickInfo.name: Second completion
quickInfo.summary: Raise all yellow targets from 50 to 200.

quickInfo.name: Third completion
quickInfo.summary: Raise all green targets from 50 to 200.

quickInfo.name: Fourth completion
quickInfo.summary: Change green targets to Special, which may be valueless in tournament play.

steps.text: Send the ball up the playfield and collect whichever of 1, 2, 3, or 4 is still missing.
Complete the first set to raise the top rollover values to 200.
Complete the second and third sets to raise the yellow and then green targets to 200.
After three sets, leave one number incomplete and repeat the other 200-point shots when possible.
Read side-lane exits and nudge before the rebound from the lower post commits toward an outlane.
Complete 1-2-3-4 once to raise the top lanes.
Complete it twice more to raise both target colors.
Hold the fourth set one number short while repeating the upgraded shots.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play, Special conversion, whether targets 1 and 4 spot both outside numbers, and whether the fourth completion remains strategically harmful under tournament settings.
Test all numbered top, side, return, and outlane switches; all yellow and green targets; sequence lamps and reset; value lamps; posts, slings, and return-lane feeds.
